title: Radio: John Lennon and Yoko ono for DPRO Vrijdag and The Joe Blow Show | 1972
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono recorded two radio appearances on 7 January 1972.

They were for two shows in the Netherlands: VPRO Vrijdag and The Joe Blow Show. The interviewers for both were Ineke van den Bergen and Peter Flik.

Lennon and Ono spoke about a possible tour, which they envisaged involving local musicians at each show. They expressed hopes to play in the USA, China, Russia, and Europe.
